Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def solve(t):
    Hh,Ww=len(t),len(t[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in t for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    src=[(i,j) for i in range(Hh) for j in range(Ww) if t[i][j]==3]
    tgt=[(i,j) for i in range(Hh) for j in range(Ww) if t[i][j]==2]
    out=[r[:] for r in t]
    def walls(i,j): return not(0<=i<Hh and 0<=j<Ww) or t[i][j]!=bg
    seg=set(src); tgtset=set(tgt)
    def run(h,d0):
        i,j=h; di,dj=d0; filled=[]
        for _ in range(4*Hh*Ww):
            ni,nj=i+di,j+dj
            if (ni,nj) in tgtset: break
            if walls(ni,nj): 
                # turn toward target
                perp=[(1,0),(-1,0)] if dj!=0 else [(0,1),(0,-1)]
                cand=[p for p in perp if not walls(i+p[0],j+p[1])]
                if not cand: break
                ti,tj=min(tgtset,key=lambda z:abs(z[0]-i)+abs(z[1]-j))
                best=min(cand,key=lambda p:(abs(p[0]-ti)+abs(p[1]-tj)))
                di,dj=best; continue
            i,j=ni,nj; filled.append((i,j))
        return filled
    best=None
    for h in src:
        for dj in (1,-1):
            hh=(h[0],h[1]+dj)
            if hh not in seg: v=run(h,(0,dj)); if best is None or len(v)<len(best): best=v
        for di in (1,-1):
            hh=(h[0]+di,h[1])
            if hh not in seg: v=run(h,(di,0)); if best is None or len(v)<len(best): best=v
    for i,j in best: out[i][j]=3
    return out

# Hypothesis: greedy snake, start at source-end FARthest from target, heading away from target;
# move straight until next cell blocked (wall/obstacle/edge); then turn toward target among unblocked perpendicular dirs;
# stop filling when the NEXT cell in current heading would be the target (adjacent). Also when perpendicular move would
# make zero progress toward target? Implement and test on both demos.
from collections import deque, Counter
def solve(t):
    Hh,Ww=len(t),len(t[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in t for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    src=[(i,j) for i in range(Hh) for j in range(Ww) if t[i][j]==3]
    tgt=[(i,j) for i in range(Hh) for j in range(Ww) if t[i][j]==2]
    out=[r[:] for r in t]
    def blocked(i,j): return not(0<=i<Hh and 0<=j<Ww) or t[i][j] not in (bg,) 
    seg=set(src)
    def man(z,sz): return abs(z[0]-sz[0])+abs(z[1]-sz[1])
    # head = source end farthest from target centroid
    ci=sum(p[0] for p in src)/len(src); cj=sum(p[1] for p in src)/len(src)
    ct=sum(p[0] for p in tgt)/len(tgt); cc=sum(p[1] for p in tgt)/len(tgt)
    far=max(src,key=lambda z:man((ci,cj),z))
    # initial heading: away from target centroid
    di,dj=(far[0]-ci>0)-(far[0]-ci<0) or 0,(far[1]-cj>0)-(far[1]-cj<0)
    tgtset=set(tgt)
    def run():
        # iterate state machine
        i,j=far; steps=0
        while steps<4*(Hh*Ww):
            steps+=1
            ni,nj=i+di,dj
            if (ni,nj) in tgtset: return (i,j)  # adjacent -> stop, mark nothing? actually previous cell was last
            if blocked(ni,nj):
                # turn toward target: perpendicular dirs reducing manhattan
                perp=[(1,0),(-1,0)] if dj!=0 else [(0,1),(0,-1)]
                cand=[p for p in perp if not blocked(i+p[0],j+p[1])]
                if not cand: return (i,j)
                p=min(cand,key=lambda z:man((ct,cc),z))
                di,dj=p
                continue
            i,j=ni,nj
        return (i,j)
    final=run()
    # trace the actual path by replaying
    return final

    T=set(tgt)
    ti=sum(p[0] for p in tgt)/len(tgt); tj=sum(p[1] for p in tgt)/len(tgt)
    best=None

            if not(0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W) or t[n[0]][n[1]]!=bg:

                cand=[p for p in perp if not blocked(i+p[0],j+p[1])]
                if not cand: return None
                d=min(cand,key=lambda p:(abs(i+p[0]-ti)+abs(j+p[1]-tj)))
                continue
            i,j=n; fill.append(n)
        return fill
    for s in src:

def solve(t):
    H,W=len(t),len(t[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in t for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    src=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if t[i][j]==3]
    tgt=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if t[i][j]==2]
    out=[r[:] for r in t]
    def blocked(i,j): return not(0<=i<H and 0<=j<W) or t[i][j] not in (bg,3)
    T=set(tgt)
    ti=sum(p[0] for p in tgt)/len(tgt); tj=sum(p[1] for p in tgt)/len(tgt)
    names={'up':(-1,0),'down':(1,0),'left':(0,-1),'right':(0,1)}
    def sim(start,d0):
        i,j=start; d=d0; fill=[]
        for _ in range(4*H*W):
            n=(i+d[0],j+d[1])
            if n in T: break
            if not(0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W) or t[n[0]][n[1]]!=bg:
                perp=[(1,0),(-1,0)] if d[1]==0 else [(0,1),(0,-1)]
                cand=[p for p in perp if not blocked(i+p[0],j+p[1])]
                if not cand: return None
                d=min(cand,key=lambda p:(abs((i+p[0])-ti)+abs((j+p[1])-tj)))
                continue
            i,j=n; fill.append(n)
        return fill
    best=None
    for s in src:
        for name,d in names.items():
            n=(s[0]+d[0],s[1]+d[1])
            if not(0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W) or t[n[0]][n[1]]!=bg: continue
            f=sim(s,d)
            if f is not None and (best is None or len(f)<len(best)): best=f
    for i,j in best: out[i][j]=3
    return out

def solve(t):
    Hh,Ww=len(t),len(t[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in t for x in r); bgv=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    src=[(i,j) for i in range(Hh) for j in range(Ww) if t[i][j]==3]
    tgt=[(i,j) for i in range(Hh) for j in range(Ww) if t[i][j]==2]
    T=set(tgt)
    ti=sum(p[0] for p in tgt)/len(tgt); tj=sum(p[1] for p in tgt)/len(tgt)
    def blocked(a,b): return not(0<=a<Hh and 0<=b<Ww) or t[a][b]!=bgv
    names={'up':(-1,0),'down':(1,0),'left':(0,-1),'right':(0,1)}
    best=None
    def sim(start,d0):
        vis={start}; dd=d0; i,j=start; fill=[]
        for _ in range(4*Hh*Ww):
            n=(i+dd[0],j+dd[1])
            if n in T: break
            if blocked(n[0],n[1]):
                perp=[(1,0),(-1,0)] if dd[1]==0 else [(0,1),(0,-1)]
                cand=[p for p in perp if not blocked(i+p[0],j+p[1]) and (i+p[0],j+p[1]) not in vis]
                if not cand: return None
                dd=min(cand,key=lambda p:(abs((i+p[0])-ti)+abs((j+p[1])-tj)))
                continue
            i,j=n; fill.append(n); vis.add(n)
        return fill
    # try all 4 directions from each source cell; require first step free; pick shortest valid path
    for s in src:
        for name,d in names.items():
            n=(s[0]+d[0],s[1]+d[1])

            f=sim(s,d)

    out=[r[:] for r in t]
    for i,j in best: out[i][j]=3
    return out
